notes.title: Patch 23/06/2020
notes.notes:
In this patch there are two changes we made that I want to highlight.[list]
[*]The game defaults to uncensored images!
[*]Preparations are made for the addition of free 'Image Packs'.
[/list]
	
[h1]The game defaults to uncensored images![/h1]
We have had confusion about the lewdness of our game, and the accessibility of said lewdness. There are players that have not accessed the nude images in our game while expressing that they do want them. This is because they didn’t know how to apply the patch.

We have changed it so the game now defaults to uncensored images and the censor can be applied via the options menu. This is because most people want the uncensored version. If you feel like you want to censor the images the option remains. For players that already have set the censor option beforehand will keep the option the way they set it.

[h1]Preparations are made for the addition of 'Image Packs'.[/h1]
This one is more an announcement for an announcement. We want to continue supporting the game with - as regular as we can - content updates in the form of packages. The Image Packs can be played independent of the main campaign and are selectable from the gallery.

We have implemented the code to allow for the Image Packs in this patch. We are working to get content updates as we speak. We are actively looking for artists to collaborate with. If you guys know an artist you would love to see in our game, hit us up on the socials and we will see if we can work something out.

notes.title: Patch 06/06/2020
notes.notes:
In preparation of our launch on Monday we have done tons of small optimization and cleanup of the code. We have been testing on windows 7, 8.1 and 10 machines to make sure the game runs properly.

We have implemented our keyboard support system to enable the game to be played with a keyboard as well as a mouse. Although we still do recommend just using the mouse, we wanted you all to have the option to use your keyboard.

Performance should be up across the board! <3

notes.title: Patch 28/05/2020
notes.notes:
The game has been playable for the playtesters for a couple of days now and we wanna thank all of you for every bit of feedback we have gotten.

Below we want to present our first offical patch notes to adress some issues people are having.

[h3]PatchNotes[/h3][list][*] The scaling of tiles changed on about half our images to better fit the screen without to much tearing and stretching of the Tiles. This should result in a better fiting puzzle.
[*] The sound effects can now play on a second Voice. This allows sound effects to overlap without cutting the sound off.
[*] One of the images on the second page was repeated on the third page. This issue has been solved and the third page puzzle now shows the correct image.
[*] The trailer and the Steam page showed conflicting release dates, this is because the trailer used the earliest known date. The trailer has been updated to reflect the correct date, this being the 8th of June!
[/list]
[h3]Notes[/h3]Then There were several questions regarding the ability to censor or remove the sensor on images in game instead of the options file outside the game. Currently the Censor toggle is not going to be in the options menu of the game. There might be one added at a later date depending on Steam support input.

The achievements progress regarding statistics are stored locally on the computer. Progress can be made on them without an active connection to Steam. The achievements will appear when connecting to steam. The achievements do stagger to not fire too many achievements at the same time, this might cause a delay in the achievements actually popping up in game.
